name: Soyuz RUO orientation hand controller
view: the RUO from behind, as the commander in the couch sees it at the right hand: the upright ribbed handle with its rounded top on the square gimbal housing; tilted for pitch and roll, twisted for yaw
origin: JoyPro's own vector drawing: the handle and housing reconstructed from the public Soyuz-TM / MS descriptions (RSC Energia and NASA Soyuz crew overviews, Wikipedia) and public museum and training photos looked at for proportions; not traced from a photo.
